company.name: Spindle AI
company.shortDescription: Spindle AI’s agentic business analytics platform helps finance, ops, and revenue teams solve optimization & what-if questions in seconds.
company.description:
Salesforce enters intro definitive agreement to acquire Spindle AI, accelerating Agentforce, the enterprise AI platform: https://salesforce.com/news/stories/salesforce-signs-definitive-agreement-to-acquire-spindle-ai

Backed by Accel Partners (Cursor/Perplexity/Atlassian) and Caffeinated Capital (Airtable/Notion/IFTTT), Spindle AI (https://spindle.ai) is your intelligent copilot for agentic business analytics and scenario planning. Instantly place a virtual data scientist or operations analyst at the fingertips of every budget stakeholder to generate scenarios, simulate “what‑ifs”, summarize trade‑offs… and still have time for lunch. Spindle is lovingly built by machine learning & analytics entrepreneurs/engineers from Tableau, Google, Stanford University, Facebook, and others who share our mission to augment human cognition with intelligent analytics. Come shape the future with us: https://spindle.ai

productsAndServices.description: A platform that enables Strategic Finance teams to generate, compare, and analyze thousands of business scenarios rapidly using AI agents and multidimensional data models.
productsAndServices.name: Spindle AI Generative Business Analytics Platform

productsAndServices.description: AI agents that generate auditable scenario models, solve constrained optimization problems, and simulate business scenarios using quantitative methods within the Spindle platform.
productsAndServices.name: AI Agents for Financial and Prescriptive Analytics

productsAndServices.description: A feature that allows users to input ranged values instead of single-point assumptions to better capture uncertainty and variability in financial models.
productsAndServices.name: Multi-Valued Assumptions (MVAs)

productsAndServices.description: A scenario analytics engine that systematically tests all relevant possibilities and constraints to simulate tradeoffs and pressure-test assumptions in enterprise forecasting.
productsAndServices.name: Scenario Landscapes

productsAndServices.description: A tag-based data modeling feature that allows users to dynamically restructure and pivot financial models and analyses without extensive schema reconfiguration.
productsAndServices.name: On-the-Fly Multidimensionality

productsAndServices.description: A data integration engine that harmonizes and processes large-scale relational and multidimensional data from multiple FP&A sources for unified analysis.
productsAndServices.name: Fusion Data Engine
